tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /tshe dbang mda' 'phel ma bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru ā yur+dz+nyā nā ya/stong nyid tshe dbang mda' bzang gis/ /'chi bdag mun 'joms stobs 'phel ba/ /nya
༄༅/ /tshe dbang mda' 'phel ma bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru ā yur+dz+nyā nā ya/stong nyid tshe dbang mda' bzang gis/ /'chi bdag mun 'joms stobs 'phel ba/ /nya

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /tshe dbang mda' 'phel ma bzhugs so// na mo gu ru ā yur+dz+nyā nā ya/ stong nyid tshe dbang mda' bzang gis/ /'chi bdag mun 'joms stobs 'phel ba/ /nyer stsol dam pa'i zhabs btud nas/ /grub gzhung dag snang gsal byed spel/ /de la 'di'i sbyor ba bshams ni/ dben zhing nyams dga' byin chen gyi gnas su stegs bu rten khebs sogs kyis bkab steng 'bras sogs 'bru bzang gcal du bkram pa'i khar dkyil 'khor gru bzhi sgo bzhi shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba'i nang du pad+ma 'dab brgyad pa'i mdog mtshungs pa'am/ dmar po gang bde/ gzhan rnams lha dgu ma dang 'dra ba/ lha gnas su so so'i gdan la lha'i mtshan ma bkod/ de ltar ma 'byor na/ maṇ+ḍal khar lha grangs dang mthun pa'i tshom bu bkod dam/ yang na 'don cha bzhin ras bris su byas pa'i dbus mañdzi de'i steng du bum pa chu/ bum rdzas mgul chings dang bcas pa/ de'i steng du thod pa'i nang du tshe chang / de'i steng du tshe bum/ de la tshe mda' tshigs gsum rgod sgro ma/ sngar sa la ma brgyab cing srog chags bsad pa ma yin pa zhig la dar dmar me long tshe g.yu zhes drug dkar dmar ram g.yu spus legs gas chag med pa btags pa btsugs/ mtho brtsigs byed ma thub na/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/ mañdzi'i khar bum pa/ g.yas su tshe chang / rgyab tu tshe bum la tshe mda' dang bcas pa/ mdun du las bum/ g.yon du nang mchod/ de thams cad gzungs thag gis bskor ba'i sna dpon slob thams cad kyi g.yon pa'i srin mdzub kyis bzung la cho ga mdzod/ tshe bum zlum gtor 'bri mog byugs pa rgyan ldan mtha' tshe ril gyis bskor ba'am/ bum gzugs gang rung tshe ril tshogs rdzas/ byang shar mtshams 'dzin nas byang du zhal zas bar chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod kyis bskor/ slob dpon gyi mdun du rdo rje dril bu/ ḍā ma ru/ me tog rin po che sna bdun/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad sogs dang bgegs gtor rnams bshams/

slob dpon gyi sngon du bdag bskyed sogs mi dgos pa mnyam du bsgrub pa mdzad de/ slob ma rnams khrus byas gral la 'khod pa dang / slob dpon gyis las bum gyi chu la dmigs te/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ ci 'grub bzlas chu de thams cad la bsang gtor byed/ bgegs gtor la a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod du gtor ma 'dod pa'i yon tan lngas gang ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs/ mchog sbyin se gol bcas oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ad+ya nut+pan nā twad oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum gyis bsngos/ 'byung po mthu bo che dkar phyogs la dga' ba rnams kyis dkyil 'khor bya ba mthar phyin par mdzod cig gang dag nag po'i phyogs gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang ba rnams 'dir ma gnas par song zhig rdo rje gsor dril bu drag tu dkrol/ rol mo'i bye brag gzhan sgrogs na'ang drag brdung tu byas la/ oṃ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha ni hūm̐/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐/ gṛh+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya hūm̐/ ā na ya ho bha ga wan/ bid+ya rā dza hūm̐ phaṭa/ gtor ma phyir dor/ rol mo rnams bzhag oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swā bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba/ drwa ba/ gur/ bla re/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ gsum/ las kyi rdo rjes maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba zhu zhes dang / oṃ badz+ra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi yongs su dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi'i steng du/ oṃ badz+ra re ṣe āḥhūm̐/ phyi lcags ri khor yug gi bskor ba'i dbus su hūm̐/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling / nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ nyi ma/

zla ba/ lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma dang mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa/ dbyer ma mchis pa la tshe dbang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rje 'gro ba'i don du bzhes pa dang / bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod/ bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi nye gnas rje ras chen dpal 'byor bzang pos tsā ri zil chen phug dang / gnas chen zab phu la sogs pa rnams su sgrub pa lo 'ga' mdzad pa la/ gsang sngags phyi nang gi yi dam gyi lha mang pos zhal gzigs/ khyad par 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku brnyes pa de nyid la thun mong ma yin pa'i zab khyad can gdams ngag mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs thul le ba gsum ste/ nai gu ma la dngos su gsan pa'i gtum mo zhag bdun ma/ 'pho ba 'ja' tshugs ma/ khyad par slob dpon rin po che pad ma 'byung gnas kyi rang zhal sgrib med du bstan pa'i tshe dbang khyad par can 'di gnang zhing / de nas rim par brgyud da lta'i bar du brgyud pa bar ma chad pa yin no/ /brgyud pa de las byung ba'i gdams pa 'di/ bya ba'i rgyud kyi pad+ma rigs kyi gtso bo tshe dpag med kyi rgyud/ de yang gdams ngag gi 'grel tshul gyis rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i tshul du legs par bkral bar/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum gyi/ dang po la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis kyi dang po ni/ bdag gzhan sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal 'di zhes tshad bzung med pa zhig rig pa sgrib pas bdag 'dzin gyi rkyen byas srid gsum du 'khyams pa'i tshe na srog gcod ma byin len 'dod log ste lus kyi las gsum/ rdzun phra ma tshig rtsub ngag 'khyal te ngag gi las bzhi/ brnab sems gnod sems log lta ste yid kyi las gsum gyis mtshon pa'i mi dge ba du ma bsags pas tsha dmyal brgyad/ nye 'khor/ nyi tshe/ grang dmyal brgyad/ yi dwags phyi nang gi sgrib pa can/

sgrib pa can gyi sgrib pa can/ kha 'thor ba/ dud 'gro byings zhes rgya mtsho na gnas pa/ gling bar mun pa na gnas pa/ kha 'thor ba mtho ris na gnas pa sogs ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal rgyun chad med pa dang / mi la yod pa srung skyob/ med pa rtsol sgrub/ dgra dang phrad pa/ gnyen dang bral ba/ chen po rnams la sems kyi sdug bsngal/ dman pa rnams la lus kyi sdug bsngal/ skye ba mngal la dogs pa/ rgas pa lang tsho 'joms pa/ na ba nad med 'joms pa/ 'chi ba srog 'joms pa sogs myong grub ma rnams dang / lha min la 'thab rtsod/ 'dod khams lha la/ 'chi ltas lnga dang / nye ba'i 'chi ltas lnga sogs byung dus dmyal ba'i lus kyi sdug bsngal las che ba'i sems kyi sdug bsngal/ gzugs dang / gzugs med kyi lha rnams la dge ba'i 'phen pa rdzogs nas log ltas ngan song du skye ba'i sdug bsngal/ sgyur rgyal bran du gyur pa/ brgya byin tha mal 'gyur ba/ nyi zla mun par 'jug pa/ snod kyi 'jig rten 'jig pa/ bcud kyi sems can sngar gyi sa na gcig kyang ma gnas pa/ bar do'i 'gro ba rnams la 'jigs pa'i sgra bzhi/ ma nges pa'i rtags drug ya nga ba'i g.yang sa gsum sogs mdor na sdug bsngal gyi yo lang sdug bsngal gyi snying po kho na las ma 'das shing sdug bsngal can gyi sems can de rnams ni rang cag rnams 'khor ba lu gu rgyud dang rgyun chad med par 'khor ba'i tshe pha ma lan grangs du ma byas pa'i drin can sha stag yin kyang las kyis mnar zhing skye 'chi 'phos pas ngo ma shes par grogs su bzung nas phan tshun gnod pa skyel res kyi drin lan log 'jal byas pa'i rdza mkhan gyi 'khor lo ltar rgyun chad med par srid pa'i sdug bsngal la 'khyams pa yin pas de las thar ba'i phyir/ da lam dge ba'i 'phen pa cung zad kyis dal 'byor mi lus thob dus 'dir 'bad dgos/ lus rten 'di ni dge ba bcu dang tshul khrims bsrung ba las byung ba'i thob pa'i rgyu de dkon/

lus longs ba'i sems can las ma longs pa'i sems can mang zhing lus longs pa'i dmyal ba sa chen po'i rdul tsam/ yi dwags kha ba bu yug tsam/ dud 'gro chang gi sbang ma tsam yod pa'i grangs la bltas na spyir mtho ris kyi lus rten dkon pa dang / khyad par dal 'byor mi lus thob pa grangs kyang dkon/ rgya mtshor gnas pa'i gnya' shing bug gcig pa sa gcig tu mi gnas pararlung gis bskyod pa'i bug par/ rgya mtsho'i gting na gnas pa'i rus sbal long ba lo brgya re nas steng du thon pa'i mgrin pa gnya' shing de'i bug par chud pa srid tsam yin pa dang / khab rtse gyen bstan thog yungs dkar khal mang blugs kyang rtser chags pa srid pa tsam dang / gyang ldeb la sran ma gtor ba de'i ngos la chags pa srid tsam sogs grangs kyi sgo nas kyang dkon/ ngo bo ngan song gsum dang / lha tshe ring po/ kla klo/ log lta can/ sangs rgyas kyis stong pa'i 'jig rten/ lkugs pa ste/ chos byed mi khom pa'i gnas brgyad dang bral/ spyir mir skyes de yang sangs rgyas kyi 'khor rnam bzhi gang rung bzhugs pa'i yul dbus su skye/ dbang po skyon med tshang / dam chos la snying nas dad pa thob/ mtshams med kyi las rang gis ma byas/ gzhan byed ma bcug byas pa la rjes su yi rangs ma skyes pa ste rang 'byor lnga/ sangs rgyas byon/ chos gsungs/ bstan pa gnas/ de'i rjes su rang gzhan 'jug chos byed kyi gang zag la mthun rkyen bsgrub pa ste gzhan 'byor lnga bcas chos bco brgyad tshang dgos pas na ngo bo'i sgo nas kyang dkon/ dkon pa'i rten de thob na yid bzhin gyi nor bu las kyang phan yon che ste/ nor bus tshe 'di'i dbul ba sel ba tsam yin/ lus rten 'dis tshe 'di'i bde skyid phyi ma lha mi'i bde ba/ nyan rang dman pa'i byang chub bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub bar yang bsgrub nus shing / don chen gyi lus de myur du 'jig chos can nges par 'chi/

nam 'chi cha med/ 'chi tshe gnyen 'brel 'khor g.yog longs spyod kha drag dpung stobs gang gi'ang ngo mi lta bar sgren mo lag stong rgyus med rgyal khams su gcig pur sdug bsngal du ma dang bcas 'gro ba'i dus shig ring por mi thogs par yong bas/ de'i tshe chos pa rab drod/ 'bring mi 'tsher/ mtha' ma mi 'gyod pa'i dpa' gdeng thob pa'i phyir dam pa'i chos nyams su len pa la brtson dgos/ de yang rang gcig pu 'khor ba las thar ba'i nyan rang gi byang chub de ni khrel med pa yin pas/ sems can thams cad 'khor ba las sgrol dgos kyang / rang dang 'jig rten pa'i chen po nyan rang sogs la de'i mthu med/ srid pa 'khor ba dang zhi ba myang 'das kyi mtha' mnan pa'i rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la de mnga' ba bzhin bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du mgon po tshe dpag med pa'i go 'phang thob pa'i phyir de'i smin grol lam rim rnams kyi nang nas kyang dag snang byin rlabs can gyi tshe dbang 'di zhus la nyams len la 'bad par bgyi'o snyam pa'i byang chub kyi thugs bskyed nas gsan 'tshal lo/ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa la/ gsol ba gdab pas rgyun bshags/ sngon 'gro'i sems bskyed pa/ rigs lnga'i sdom pa blang ba dang gsum gyi dang po ni/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam sbyong ba/ /de ring bshad pa'i rin chen gter/ /gtso bos bdag la bka' drin skyobs/ /khyed zhabs pad+mo spangs nas ni/ /gtso bo gzhan la skyabs ma mchis/ /'gro ba'i dpa' bo mthu chen gyis/ /blo mchog bdag la gnang bar mdzod/ /lan gsum/ gnyis pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rangs/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du bdag skyabs 'chi/ /rang gzhan don ni rang sgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/

/byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing / /sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /lan gsum/ gsum pa ni/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dgongs su gsol/ /bdag gis 'gro drug sems can kun don du/ /gsang ba sngags kyi dam tshig gzung bar bgyi/ /rdo rje'i rigs dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs/ /rin chen rigs dang skyon bral pad+ma'i rigs/ /las kyi rigs sogs dam tshig ma lus pa/ /rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig bzung bar bgyi/ /gsang ba sngags kyi rnal 'byor 'grub par mdzod/ /ces pa rnams lan gsum rjes zlos byed/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i bskyed rim gsal btab ste gzungs bzla ba/ de rdzogs rim du bsdus te sngags bzla ba/ bskyed rim du langs nas tshe 'gugs pa/ dbang bskur ba/ dbang lha bstims pa dang lnga'i dang po ni 'di nas dmigs bsal ma gtogs/ slob dpon gyi rjes zlos mdzad dgos pas rjes zlos dang sbrags dmigs pa bsgom tshul ni/ gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa yar rtse srid rtser slebs pa/ yar dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi la thug pa/ yang na dma' na rag dmyal ba'i gnas la zug pa/ lte ba shin du yangs shing rgya che ba stong gsum tsam gyi nang du maṇ+ḍal bum pa pho brang gzhal yas khang / zhes pa'i gzhal yas khang rgyan rta babs thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su bdag cag dpon slob rnams dang mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor tshe rdzas thams cad ye shes rang snang las grub pa'i lha tshogs su bskyed pa ni gsal stong 'ja' tshon lta bur gsal bar bsgom dgos pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ skad cig tsam gyis rdo rje chen po'i nang / /maṇ+ḍal bum pa pho brang gzhal yas khang / /'dab brgyad gru bzhi sgo bzhi lcags ri bcas/ /pad+ma nyi ma zla ba'i gdan steng du/ /de yi dbus su rang byung a gcig bsam/

/de las 'od 'phros 'khor 'das bcud bsdus nas/ /tshur 'dus a las rang nyid tshe dpag med/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dmar la dwangs/ /gser dngul rin chen mu tig phreng bas brgyan/ /sna tshogs dar gyi na bza' sham thabs gsol/ /phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag bdud rtsi'i bum pa bsnams/ /de nyid pang na gnyis med gsal ba yum/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis dmar mo bum pa 'dzin/ /rgyan dang cha lugs gtso bo yab dang mtshungs/ /de'i shar sogs pad+ma nyi zla'i steng / /rdo rje mkha' 'gro rin chen mkha' 'gro dang / /pad+ma mkha' 'gro las kyi mkha' 'gro rnams/ /mthing gi bum pa gser gyi bum pa dang / /pad+ma rā ga in+d+ra nī la yi/ /bum pa rim bzhin tshe yis gang ba 'dzin/ /mtshams bzhi'i 'dab mar sgeg phreng glu gar ma/ /sngo ser dmar ljang mdzes ldan bum pa bsnams/ /nang du zhal gzigs gtso bo'i zhal la blta/ /gru chad bzhi la mchod pa'i lha mo bzhi/ /me tog bdug spos snang gsal mchod yon rnams/ /dkar ser dmar ljang gar stabs tshul gyis bzhugs/ /sgo bzhir lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril/ /dkar ser dmar ljang sgeg pa'i tshul du bzhugs/ /de ltar lha rnams snang stong rang bzhin med/ /gsal stong 'ja' tshon lta bur gsal bar gyur/ /gtso bo yab yum gnyis med thugs ka ru/ /pad+ma snying gi ze'u 'bru lta bu'i steng / /tshe yi ngo bo dkar la 'tsher ba la/ /yi ge a ni dkar po mtshan par gyur/ /de la tshe yi snying po 'od dang ldan/ /me tog phreng ba lta bus bskor ba bzhugs/ /rlung ro lan gsum phyi la sangs kyis bus/ /dug gsum rtog pa ma lus sangs kyis dag /steng 'og rlung gnyis snying khar kha sbyar bzung / de nas rlung ro lan gsum bus nas bum can zhes 'og rlung rtsa 'then/ steng rlung sna bug gnyis nas dal bar rngubs mchil ma'i rta bcas 'tshir gnon gyi rjes su 'og rlung rdzogs par 'then/ lte bar kha sbyor du 'dzin dgos pas/

dpon slob thams cad kyis sna bug g.yas nas rlung thengs gcig bus pas nyon mongs pa zhe sdang gi rtog pa thams cad sngo bun bun 'thon par bsam/ g.yon nas thengs gcig bus pas nyon mongs pa/ 'dod chags kyi rtog pa thams cad dmar bun bun 'thon par bsam/ dbus nas thengs gcig bus pas nyon mongs pa gti mug gi rtog pa thams cad nag bun bun 'thon par bsam/ de ltar lan gsum bus rjes bum pa can gzung dgos pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ snying kha'i rnam shes pad+ma kha bye nas/ /a las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pa yis/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar rang 'dra'i ye shes pa/ /ma hā gu ru tshe dpag med pa yi/ /rigs kyi lha tshogs thams cad byon par gyur/ /brjod la rlung ro bsal ba dang / bum can thams cad kyis 'dzin mi thub na sna bug gnyis nas dal gyis btang la/ de nas mdun du spyan drangs pa la yan lag bdun pas 'bul ba ni/ yang rjes zlos/ ma hā gu ru o rgyan pad+ma dang / /bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med pa yi/ /rigs kyi lha tshogs 'khor bcas thams cad la/ /kun nas bdag gis gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos su bshams dang yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho rnams/ /kun tu bzang po mchod sprin rgya mtsho ltar/ /bdag gis ma lus kun la dbul bar bgyi/ /'khor ba thog ma med pa'i dus nyid nas/ /da lta'i dus kyi lus ngag yid gsum gyis/ /phra rags sbom gsum sdig pa ci bgyis pa/ /bdag nyid gnong zhing 'gyod pa'i sgo nas bshags/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i yon tan dpag med dang / /sems can kun gyi dad dang brtson 'grus kyi/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis mthar thug pa/ /dge ba kun la bdag ni rjes yi rangs/ /dus gsum 'gyur med rdo rje tshe yi lha/ kun la khyab pa byang chen thugs rje'i dpal/ byin rlabs chen po'i sku gsum 'phrin las kyis/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bdag gis bskul/

/sku gsum 'phrin las rgyun chad med pa ru/ /ji srid 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma stongs bar/ /mkha' mnyam sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs/ /bcom ldan khyod la phyag 'tshal mchod sogs pa'i/ /'gro kun dge ba'i rtsa ba ji snyed pa/ /rnam mkhyen kun mkhyen go 'phang thob bya'i phyir/ /bla med byang chub chen por bsngo bar bgyi/ /gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med pa yi/ /rigs kyi lha tshogs 'khor bcas thams cad kyis/ /grub mchog bdag la dbang dang byin rlabs pa'i/ /rdo rje tshe mchog dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ /de nas rjes zlos med par/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab pas gu ru'i bum pa nas tshe dpag med kyi bum par bdud rtsi babs/ de nyid bdag gi tshangs pa'i bu ga nas mar babs par bsams nas/ tshe dpag med rigs lnga'i dbang bskur/ 'di'i bar slob dpon nyid kyis brjod/ yang rjes zlos/ dam tshig sems dpa' so so'i lha tshogs la/ /ye shes sems pa dgug gzhug gnyis med bstim/ /gnyis med rgyas pa lha yi spyi gtsug tu/ /ma hā gu ru rigs kyi bdag por gyur/ /de nas slob dpon nyid kyis ye shes dbab pa ni/ mdun gyi lha tshogs rnams dang / gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'chi med tshe'i lha tshogs thams cad khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo la sogs pa ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas char bzhin babs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra rat+na nas pha la hūm̐ bar/ sngags brjod cing ḍā dril sogs rol chen gu gul gyi dud pa dang bcas par bya/ rol mo bzhag dam tshig sems dpa' so so'i lha tshogs la/ /ye shes sems dpa' dgug gzhug gnyis med bstims/ /gnyis med dgyes pa lha yi spyi gtsug tu/ /ma hā gu ru rigs kyi bdag por gyur/ /yang rjes zlos/ de la lha tshogs gsal bar bsgoms pa yi/ /gtso bo'i thugs ka'i āḥyig 'od zer las/

/snying po'i sngags 'khor rang sgra byung ba las/ /yab yum zhal nas snying po'i sngags 'di bzlas/ /dpon slob thams cad kyis gzungs thag bzung ba la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra rat+na ā yu ṣe hūm̐ bh+rūm̐/ tshe bh+rūm̐/ g.yu bh+rūm̐/ nṛ bh+rūm̐/ ban+dha bh+rūm̐/ ā yur dz+nyā na bh+rūm̐/ oṃ a ma ra ṇi dzī wān+ti sid+dhīḥpha la hūm̐/ zhes pas sngags lan ci rigs bzlas/ yang rjes zlos mdzod/ de nas lha dang sngags las 'od zer 'phros/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs bcud dang / /khams gsum sems can kun gyi tshe dpal rnams/ /bsdus nas tshur 'dus rang la thim pa yis/ /'chi med ye shes tshe yi ngo bor gyur/ /rjes zlos med par/ snod bcud srung 'khor la thim/ srung 'khor gzhal yas khang lha dang bcas pa la thim/ de rim bzhin gtso bo yab yum la thim/ yum yab la thim/ yab snying kha'i āḥl thim/ āḥni skye ba med pa chos kyi sku/ ma bcos spros bral 'od gsal chen por bzhag cung zad thams cad kyis mnyam bzhag thog ma slob dpon rang gi sngags bzla bzhin du mda' la mtho gdab mtho dang por tshad don 'dzin byas/ de nas slob ma rnams kyi'ang so so'i tshad don 'dzin byed pa'i tshe'ang slob dpon gyis sngags bzla/ de nas tshe 'gugs pa ni/ slob dpon gyis gdangs dang bcas mda' dar g.yab cing / bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med/ /shar phyogs dri za'i lag nas tshe khug cig khug cig khug cig tshe khug cig /stsol cig stsol cig tshe stsol cig /ye shes tshe yi dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ /bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med/ /shar lho me lha'i lag nas tshe khug cig /sham bu gong dang 'dra/ bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med/ /lho phyogs gshin rje'i lag nas tshe khug cig /༞༞ bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med/ /lho nub srin po'i lag nas tshe khug cig /༞༞ bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med/ /nub phyogs chu lha'i༞༞ /bcom ldan mgon po༞

/nub byang rlung lha'i lag nas tshe khug cig ༞༞ /bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med/ /byang phyogs gnod sbyin lag nas tshe khug cig ༞༞ /bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med/ /byang shar dbang ldan lag nas tshe khug cig ༞༞ /dbang po brgya byin lag nas tshe khug cig ༞༞ /lha mo brtan ma'i lag nas tshe khug cig ༞༞ /o rgyan pad+ma'i lag nas tshe khug cig ༞༞ /man+dha ra ba'i lag nas tshe khug cig /shar rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ /sku mdog sngon po mdangs dang ldan/ /phyag na tshe yi bum pa bsnams/ /'khor du sngon mo 'bum gyis bskor/ /bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ /rdo rje rigs kyi tshe khug cig /lho rin chen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ /sku mdog ser mo mdangs dang ldan/ /sham bu gis 'gre'o/ /nub pad+ma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ /sku mdog dmar mo mdangs dang ldan/ byang las kyi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ /sku mdog ljang gu mdangs dang ldan/ /dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i tshe khug cig /skyon gyis ma gos tshe khug cig /mi 'gyur brtan pa'i tshe khug cig /las kun 'grub pa'i tshe khug cig /'dir yang gzungs lan ci rigs bzlas rjes tshe mda' la sngags 'debs pa sogs dang / mtho tshad brtag dbang bskur ba dngos ni/ yang 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ 'ja' lus bum pa'i dbang mchog bskur du gsol/ /ces shes rlung gi gsang dbang bskur du gsol/ /bde chen thig le'i sher dbang bskur du gsol/ /mngon sum rig pa'i rtsal dbang bskur du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ de nas slob dpon gyis mañdzi'i kha'i bum pa blangs la/ slob ma'i spyi bo/ dpral ba/ rna ltag g.yas/ ltag pa/ rna ltag g.yon rnams su reg cing / khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo la sogs pa gnas rnams su tshe dpag med rigs lnga rim bzhin byon nas dbang bskur ba'i mos pa bya dgos pa/ bla ma dang mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka nas bye bar gyur pa'i bskur byed nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor rnam snang tshe dpag med dkar po phyag na tshe bum thogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa nam mkha' gang bar byon nas de dag gis mgrin gcig gis/

nga ni rnam snang tshe dpag med/ /ces sogs bskur tshig dang bcas dbang bskur bas lus kyi cha shas thams cad 'chi med kyi bdud rtsis gang bas khyed rang rnams kyis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas gti mug gis kun nas blangs te sems can gyi srog bcad pa la sogs pa'i tshe thung bar gyur pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa las dang nyon mongs pa shes bya'i sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sbyangs shing dag nas rnam snang tshe dpag med kyi tshe'i dngos grub thob byung snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ nga ni sangs rgyas tshe dpag med/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mgrin gcig tu/ /lus la sangs rgyas tshe dbang bskur/ /bskal pa stong du tshe 'phel zhing / /srog gcod sdig pa dag gyur cig /oṃ bhud+dha a bhi ṣīñtsa hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing / thog mar bum pa slob dpon rang gi spyi bor bzhag bum chu cung zad 'thung / de nas slob ma'i spyi bor bum pa bzhag cing bum chu sbyin/ gti mug las gyur pa'i srog gcod pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dag rnam snang gi tshe'i dngos grub thob/ de bzhin du/ nga ni mi bskyod tshe dpag med/ /ces sogs 'don pa bsgyur la/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣīñtsa hūm̐/ zhes bum chu khar blud pa rigs 'gre/ zhe sdang las gyur pa'i srog bcad pa'i sdig sgrib dag mi bskyod pa'i tshe'i dngos grub thob/ nga ni rin 'byung tshe dpag med/ /oṃ rat+na a bhi ṣīñtsa hūm̐/ ser sna las gyur pa'i srog gcod pa'i sdig sgrib dag rin 'byung gi tshe'i dngos grub thob/ nga ni pad+ma tshe dpag med/ oṃ pad+ma a bhi ṣīñtsa hūm̐/ 'dod chags las gyur pa'i srog gcod pa'i sdig sgrib dag 'od dpag med kyi tshe'i dngos grub thob/ nga ni don yod tshe dpag med/ oṃ karma a bhi ṣīñtsa hūm̐/ bum chu khar blud/ phrag dog las gyur pa'i srog gcod pa'i sdig sgrib dag don yon grub pa'i tshe'i dngos grub thob/ ces rigs lnga'i dbang bskur/

de nas spyi bor tshe dpag med tshon gang pa gcig gsal btab nas de las 'od 'phros/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi tshe dang ye shes thams cad hūm̐ yig dkar dmar gyi rnam par spyan drangs de nyid la thim/ de nyid kyang 'od du zhu nas/ spyi bo tshangs bug nas mar zhugs/ snying khar rigs lnga tshe dpag med kyi skur gyur/ de rnams 'od du zhu nas lus thams cad la khyab pas/ 'chi med tshe'i rdo rje'i ngo bor gyur par bsams nas/ slob ma'i spyi bor rdo rje bzhag nga ni ye shes tshe dpag med/ /kun tu nyes pa spang bar bya/ /'chi bdag chen po nga yis bcom/ /bu khyod tshe yi rig 'dzin brnyes/ /yang 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ a ma ra ṇi dzī wan+tī sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ zhes rang gzhan gnyis kas lan gsum gyi bar du brjod/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad bsangs sbyangs nas bkra shis des kyang bgegs kun zhi gyur cig bar/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i tshe dpag lha dgu'i dbang chog bzhin sogs tshe dpag lha dgu'i dbang chog yig cha gang rung nas 'byung ba bzhin/ yang na rgyal srid sna bdun dang rdzas brgyad la dmigs nas gong gi tshe gzungs tshar gsum bzlas/ snod gcig tu lhan cig tu khur la/ 'khor lo/ nor bu/ btsun mo/ blon po/ glang / rta/ dmag dpon rin chen bdun gyi 'byor pa spel/ me long / gi zho/ dūr/ bil/ dung / li/ yungs rdzas brgyad bkra shis de dang des dbang bskur/ oṃ sap+ta rat+na maṅga la aṣ+ṭa dra bh+yaḥ.a bhi ṣīñtsa maṃ zhes bsdus kyang chog tshe gtor rten dang brten par bcas pa'i lha tshogs su bsgoms pa'i gtso bo'i spyi bo nas yar 'di pa'i bla ma brgyud pa rnams mtho brtsegs su bzhugs pa'i 'khor sangs rgyas byang sems srung ma'i tshogs kyis bskor bar bsam nas/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos byed du gzhug ste/ 'gyur med bde ba chen po'i gzhal yas nas/ /mgon po tshe dpag med la gsol ba 'debs/

/mi shes thig le chen po tshe yi mchog /rtag brtan g.yung drung dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /rang byung pad sdong 'od kyi gzhal yas nas/ /slob dpon pad+ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /mi shigs sogs sham bu 'dra/ 'ja' lus rdo rje dbyings kyi gzhal yas nas/ /ras chen rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs/ /mi shigs thig le chen po tshe yi mchog /rang zhal rang grol chen po'i gzhal yas nas/ /chos rje rnam mgon dri med la gsol ba 'debs/ ༞ /snyan brgyud gdams pa kun 'dzin gzhal yas nas/ /'jam dbyangs byang chub rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs/ ༞ /nges don rgya mtsho 'khyil ba'i gzhal yas nas/ /mkhas grub shākya kun dga' la gsol ba 'debs/ ༞ /tshad med thugs rje mnga' ba'i gzhal yas nas/ /'bum chen kun dga' dpal 'byor la gsol ba 'debs/ ༞ /tshad med thugs rje mnga' ba'i gzhal yas nas/ /sngags 'chang kun dga' bsod nams la gsol ba 'debs/ ༞ /lung rtogs yon tan rgyas pa'i pho brang nas/ /mkhan chen bzang po rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs/ ༞ /snying rje 'gro la rjes brtse'i gzhal yas nas/ /sngags 'chang kun dga' bkra shis la gsol ba 'debs/ ༞ /grub brnyes snang srid dag pa'i gzhal yas nas/ /sgro lung bsod nams chos 'phel la gsol ba 'debs/ ༞ /mkhyen brtse nus ldan lhun grub gzhal yas nas/ /sa chen bsod nams rin chen la gsol ba 'debs/ ༞ /spyi gtsug pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du/ /drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/ ༞ /zhes gsol ba btab nas yul de rnams rim gyis zhu nas/ slob ma la bstim/ rol mo bya/ rtsa sngags bcas/ tshe zan/ tshe chang / tshe ril sogs kyis dbang bskur/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal pa sogs maṇ+ḍal la/ deng nas brtsams te/ tshe bum gyi ye shes pa rang la bsdus nas tshe zan dang tshogs 'khor la longs spyad/ de nas lhag gtor btang / rjes chog bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis rnams brjod/ 'di'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/

bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag med/ ras chen rdo rje 'chang dpal 'byor bzang po/ de la chos rje rnam rgyal mgon po dang / 'jam dbyangs byang chub dbang rgyal/ de gnyis ka la yongs 'dzin shākya kun dga'/ de nas mkhan chen byams pa bzang po/ de min gong bzhin/ yang na byang bzang gi rjes su/ kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma/ nam mkha' 'brug sgra bzang po/ byams pa shākya rdo rje/ chos rje rin chen rgya mtsho/ chos rje mang thos rgya mtsho/ gong dkar rnam grong rdo rje 'chang chos dbang rgya mtsho/ des sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la bstsal ba'o/ /'jig rten mtho ris mi yul 'dzam gling pa/ /spyi dang khyad par bod ljongs tshe phongs rnams/ /'chi med dpal la spyod phyir o rgyan rjes/ /grub dbang dpal 'byor bzang por ched bstsal ba'i/ /mda' 'phel dbang mchog 'chi med zer brgya pa/ /dam pa'i gzhung bzang dbang phyogs sa 'dzin rtser/ /shar zin 'on kyang blo dman mun sel slad/ /snang byed zhabs 'degs 'di ni sa skya pa/ /ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros zhes bya ba/ /lhag bsam che yang mgo stong kha 'chal des/ /rang gi de nyid ston dang skal mnyam ched/ /bkod pa'i nyes bshags dge des tshe bdag byon// //zhus so// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ tshe dbang mda' 'phel ma/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
